latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the web-search skill for SkillBoss API Hub.

- Provides unified web, news, image, and video search with a single API key.
- Supports time range, region, safe search, and flexible result limits.
- Returns results in plain text, markdown, or JSON formats.
- Allows advanced filtering for images (size, color, layout, type) and videos (duration, resolution).
- Includes options to save results to a file in the chosen format.
